name: Ellipsoidal (profile) spotlight
definition: Fixed stage fixture with a lens tube and shutters that throws a hard-edged, shapeable beam; also called a profile or leko.

name: Fresnel stage light
definition: Fixed stage fixture with a stepped Fresnel lens that gives a soft-edged, adjustable wash of light.

name: PAR stage light
definition: Fixed stage fixture built round a parabolic reflector or a par-can body, giving a broad wash; LED and lamp versions.

name: Moving head light
definition: Stage fixture panned and tilted by motor under DMX control, with gobo, colour or beam effects; spot, wash and beam versions.

name: Followspot
definition: Large spotlight aimed by an operator, or by remote, to follow a performer on stage.
